patients.summary: 28-year-old marketing coordinator with bulimia nervosa (purging type) and generalized anxiety, on fluoxetine with variable adherence, whose purging, steroid and diuretic misuse bring repeated electrolyte and volume emergencies, then a pregnancy complicated by hyperemesis gravidarum. Most recently admitted elsewhere with hyponatremia after a hot festival day of heavy water intake and ecstasy, after her last practice visit.

documents.title: New Patient Visit and Preventive Exam
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
21 y/o woman new to us. Came with her prior PCP's med list; records release signed today.

HPI: Wants a doctor she can actually reach. Long history of bulimia, purging type, starting in early adolescence: binge-purge cycles that come and go with stress. Not in any treatment right now; saw a therapist in high school, none since. Purging "a few times a month" lately by her estimate, sometimes more around deadlines. In the past also misused laxatives and diuretics, and went through a stretch of using anabolic steroids for body composition. Says none of that now. Generalized anxiety for several years: worry she can't switch off, poor sleep in bad weeks. Fluoxetine 20 mg from her last PCP; honest that she skips it for days at a time.

PMH: bulimia nervosa (purging), GAD, hx anabolic steroid use disorder, hx laxative/diuretic misuse.
PSH: third molars out at 18.
Meds: fluoxetine 20 mg daily (adherence variable). No OTCs or supplements per pt.
Allergies: NKDA.
FH: mother with major depression; father with GAD; maternal aunt with binge eating disorder.
SH: marketing coordinator. Never smoked. No alcohol, avoids it for the calories. Single.

PHQ-9 5, GAD-7 10.

Exam: thin, well groomed, pleasant, a little guarded when we get to food. BP and HR fine, afebrile. Weight 56 kg, height 165 cm. HEENT: no parotid enlargement, dentition intact. Neck supple, thyroid not enlarged. Heart RRR, no murmur. Lungs clear. Abdomen soft, nontender. Hands: no calluses over the knuckles. Skin warm, no lanugo. Pelvic: normal external genitalia, cervix without lesions; Pap and GC/CT collected.

A/P:
1. Bulimia nervosa, purging type - longstanding, currently not in treatment. Talked about what specialized ED care looks like; not ready for a referral today, will revisit. Baseline CMP, Mg, CBC. Asked her to tell me if she starts using laxatives or water pills again; she agreed.
2. GAD - continue fluoxetine 20 mg, I'll prescribe going forward. Pill box/phone alarm suggested.
3. Hx steroid and laxative/diuretic misuse - in remission by her report.
4. Health maintenance - Pap today (first one). GC/CT, HIV, HCV screening today. HPV series done as a teen per pt; will confirm in old records. Flu shot this fall.

RTC 3-4 months.

documents.title: After Visit Summary
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Nice to meet you today.
- Keep taking fluoxetine 20 mg once a day. A phone alarm can help.
- Blood work was drawn today. Results will post to the portal with a note from me.
- Your Pap result usually takes about a week.
- You can message or call any time, including about eating. That's what we're here for.
Next visit: about 3 to 4 months.

documents.title: Lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Taylor, your blood count, chemistry panel, magnesium and thyroid test are all normal, and the HIV, hepatitis C, gonorrhea and chlamydia screens are negative. Pap is still pending. Talk soon.

documents.title: Pap result
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Your Pap smear is normal. Next one is due in 3 years.

documents.title: Records from prior primary care office
documents.author: front desk
documents.body:
Prior primary care records received (34 pages) and scanned.

PCP review: problem list there matches ours - bulimia nervosa, purging type; generalized anxiety; history of anabolic steroid use; history of laxative and diuretic misuse. Fluoxetine 20 mg for several years with gaps in fills. Wisdom teeth removed at 18 by oral surgery. Immunizations: childhood series complete, HPV series completed in adolescence, Tdap at 11. Routine well visits with normal exams and normal basic labs. No allergies listed. Nothing that changes our plan.

documents.title: Nurse Visit - Flu Vaccine
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Flu vaccine IM L deltoid. No prior reactions, feeling well today. VIS given. Waited 15 min without issue.

procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, moderate MDM

documents.title: Follow-up Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
S: Fall busy at work with year-end campaigns. Taking fluoxetine "most days, maybe 5 of 7." Binge/purge a few times a month, no change. Denies laxatives, diuretics, steroids. Sleep ok. No dizziness or palpitations.
O: vitals fine, weight stable. Calm, good eye contact. No parotid swelling, mucous membranes moist.
PHQ-9 4, GAD-7 9.
A/P: GAD with bulimia, stable at her baseline. Continue fluoxetine 20. Raised ED-specialist referral again; she'd rather wait until after the holidays. Ok. See me in spring, sooner if purging picks up.

documents.title: Refill request
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Pharmacy fax: refill request fluoxetine 20 mg caps #90. Last visit 12/10/19. Per PCP, ok x1 with 1 refill. Sent.

procedures.procedure: Telehealth visit, established patient, low MDM

documents.title: Telehealth Follow-up
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Video, she's in her apartment, consents to telehealth.
Working from home since March. Anxiety up some with everything going on; more time alone with food makes the binge/purge harder to manage, a few times a week some weeks. Denies laxatives/diuretics/steroids. Fluoxetine mostly daily since we refilled. No syncope, no palpitations.
PHQ-9 6, GAD-7 11.
Looks well on screen, speech normal, affect a bit flat.
A/P: GAD, bulimia - modest worsening with isolation. Structure: regular meal times, getting outside. Continue fluoxetine 20 mg. Offered ED program referral; she says she'll think about it and message me. Labs at her physical in the fall unless purging escalates.

documents.title: Nurse Visit - Flu Vaccine
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Masked visit. Influenza vaccine given IM R deltoid, lot recorded. Tolerated, left in good spirits.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Annual. Back in the office, mostly remote for work.
Interval: anxiety about the same, GAD-7 10. Purging "a little better than the summer." Denies laxatives, diuretics, steroids. Regular periods. Fluoxetine most days. Flu shot done last month.
ROS otherwise negative: no syncope, chest pain, palpitations, abdominal pain, hematemesis.
Exam: weight steady around her usual. Normal vitals. No parotid enlargement, no enamel erosion I can see, no knuckle calluses. Heart, lungs, abdomen normal. Skin and extremities normal.
A/P: healthy 22 y/o with bulimia and GAD, stable.
- CMP, Mg, CBC today.
- GC/CT screen.
- Pap not due until 2022.
- Continue fluoxetine 20.
- Counseled on contraception and sexual health; no needs today.
RTC 6 months.

documents.title: Lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Labs look good - potassium and the rest of the chemistry normal, blood count normal, STI screen negative.

documents.title: Follow-up Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
S: Doing better this spring. Running again a few times a week. Fluoxetine "pretty consistent." Purging a couple of times a month. No laxatives/diuretics/steroids.
O: BP and HR normal, weight steady. Calm, bright.
PHQ-9 4 / GAD-7 8.
A/P: GAD + bulimia, better. Continue fluoxetine. Encouraged regular fueling around runs. RTC at her physical in the fall.

documents.body: Late-day slot after work. Afebrile, no complaints. Flu vaccine IM L deltoid. VIS reviewed.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Annual exam, 23F.
Interval: new role at work, more pressure. Says she has started "eating cleaner" to drop a few pounds over the last couple of months. Purging about the same. Denies laxatives, diuretics, steroids when I ask. GAD-7 11.
ROS neg for syncope, palpitations, chest pain.
Exam: weight down a little from spring. Vitals normal. Normal general exam; no parotid enlargement.
A/P:
- Bulimia / GAD: I'm a little wary of the dieting talk given her history. Said so. She'll message if it gets away from her. Continue fluoxetine 20.
- Labs: CMP, CBC, GC/CT.
- Flu done in Oct. COVID booster - she plans to get it at the pharmacy next month.
RTC 4-6 months.
